q: Does Senseible count each page of a PDF as a separate invoice against my monthly allowance?
title: Does each PDF page count as one invoice?
short: Yes, from your account's next period. Each PDF page and each photo counts as one invoice read: from 1 November 2026 for yearly and free plans, from the next billing date for monthly plans, and for every account by 1 December 2026. Until your date, each file counts as one.
audience: Users uploading multi-page bills or scanned bundles

sections.h: When page counting reaches your account
ul: Snapshot (free) and yearly plans: from 1 November 2026, India time.
Monthly plans: from your next billing date, and not before 1 November 2026.
Every account: by 1 December 2026, even if your next billing date falls later.
Before your date: a PDF counts as one read however many pages it has.

sections.h: How to work out the reads you will need
p: Count pages, not documents. Reads a month = (PDF invoices a month x average pages per PDF) + photos a month. A three-page HT electricity bill uses three reads, and a 24-page scanned bundle of fuel slips uses 24.
Compare the total with your plan's invoice reads per calendar month: Snapshot 10, Essential 100, Pro 1,000 and Scale 10,000. Add a margin for your busiest month, such as year end.

ul: Remove blank pages, covering letters, terms and conditions and advertisement pages before you scan.
For a long bill, keep the pages that show the billing period, tariff and units consumed, and check nothing you need sits on the pages you drop.
Scan at a readable resolution the first time, so you do not upload the same pages again as a new file.

sections.h: If you run out in a month
p: Your plan's reads are used first, then any credits you bought. Extra invoice credits cost ₹79 per 100 invoices before GST and are bought on your Subscription page with UPI. Credits bought on a yearly plan last 12 months; on a monthly or free plan they last 30 days. Otherwise, the plan's reads start again next calendar month.

example.title: Worked example: one factory's month
lines: 6 electricity bills of 3 pages each: 6 x 3 = 18 reads
1 scanned bundle of fuel slips, 24 pages: 24 reads
Total with page counting: 40 + 18 + 24 + 10 = 92 reads, inside Essential's 100
Before page counting the same month was 40 + 6 + 1 + 10 = 57 files, so 57 reads
example.note: Illustrative volumes. If a busy month reaches 120 reads on Essential, one pack of 100 credits at ₹79 covers the extra 20.

senseible: This page describes Senseible's own counting rule, which is applied on the server for each account. PDFs over 10 pages are read in parts, and each page still counts once.
